data.name: Muqrin
data.gender_notes: Muqrin is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who is constantly seeking knowledge and wisdom from Allah. The name Muqrin carries the meaning “Seeker, Researcher” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Muqrin usually hope their child will grow to embody seeker, researcher and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: May Allah guide and inspire you on your journey of knowledge and understanding.
data.etymology: Muqrin belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Seeker, Researcher.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Muqrin total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_arabic.name: مقرن
in_arabic.meaning: مقرن يعني قريب أو ملتصق أو متصل بشيء ما
in_arabic.long_meaning: مقرن هو اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي و يعني قريب أو ملتصق أو متصل بشيء ما. وقد ورد في القرآن الكريم في سورة يس آية 11: 'وَمُهْمِلُوهَا مُقَرَّنُونَ' أي متصلون بها. ويستخدم هذا الاسم في الثقافة الإسلامية للإشارة إلى الشخص الذي يتصل بالله أو بشيء مقدس.

in_urdu.name: مقرن
in_urdu.meaning: مقرن مطلب ہے قریب یا منسلک یا متصل
in_urdu.long_meaning: مقرن ایک مذکر نام ہے جو عربی मूल سے ہے اور اس کا مطلب ہے قریب یا منسلک یا متصل۔ اس نام کا ذکر جنوبی ایشیاء میں مسلمانوں کے درمیان میں کیا جاتا ہے جو کسی مقدس چیز یا اللہ تعالیٰ کے ساتھ منسلک ہونے کے احساس کو ظاہر کرتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: मुक़रिन
in_hindi.meaning: मुक़रिन का अर्थ है करीब या जुड़ा हुआ
in_hindi.long_meaning: मुक़रिन एक पुरुष नाम है जो अरबी मूल से है और इसका अर्थ है करीब या जुड़ा हुआ। यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में उपयोग किया जाता है जो किसी पवित्र चीज़ या ईश्वर के साथ जुड़ने की भावना को दर्शाता है।

in_pashto.name: مقرن
in_pashto.meaning: مقرن دى قريب يا منسلک يا متصل
in_pashto.long_meaning: مقرن يو مذکر نوم دى چې عربي اصل څخه يې اخيستل شوی دی او معنی يې دى قريب يا منسلک يا متصل. دا نوم د افغان او پښتون دود په کارولو کې دى چې کوم يو څه سپېڅلي يا الله تعالی سره منسلک کيدو څرګند کړي.

in_english.name: Muqrin
in_english.meaning: Muqrin means close, connected, or attached
in_english.long_meaning: Muqrin is a masculine given name of Arabic origin, derived from the root 'q-r-n' which means to be close or connected. In Islamic tradition, the name Muqrin signifies a person who is closely connected to Allah or something sacred. The name is mentioned in the Quran in Surah Yasin, verse 11. Muqrin is used across various Muslim cultures to denote spiritual closeness and devotion.

pronunciation.urdu: اردو میں تلفظ کی تفصیل مقرن (moo-krin)
pronunciation.pashto: په پښتو کې د تلفظ تفصیل مقرن (moo-krin)

data.cultural_impact: The name Muqrin holds significant cultural value in Islamic culture as it represents a commitment to lifelong learning and intellectual growth. In Islamic tradition, seeking knowledge is considered a noble pursuit and a fundamental duty for every individual. Muqrin, being a person who is constantly engaged in this pursuit, is a source of inspiration and a model to follow for families and communities.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Muqrin signifies a deep connection to Allah and a dedication to the pursuit of knowledge and wisdom that leads to a closer relationship with the divine. Muqrin is someone who recognizes the value of learning not just for the sake of acquiring information, but for the purpose of drawing nearer to Allah and gaining a greater understanding of the divine Will and Guidance. The name presents an opportunity for reflection and self-improvement, encouraging individuals to strive for growth and deepen their faith and understanding of the world around them.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Seeker, Researcher" symbolizes One who is constantly seeking knowledge and wisdom from Allah.. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Muqrin serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of seeker, researcher.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Muqrin ibn al-Hajjaj was a prominent scholar and poet during the Umayyad Caliphate. He is known for his collection of Hadith known as Sahih Muqrin.
historical_references.context: Muqrin lived during the golden age of Islam and contributed significantly to the preservation of Hadith.

historical_references.reference: Ibn Al-Jawzi records that Muqrin ibn Rabah, a companion of Imam Ahmad ibn Hanbal, was a renowned scholar and author of numerous works on Hadith and Fiqh during the Abbasid Caliphate.
historical_references.context: Muqrin was an important figure in the development of Islamic scholarship during the Abbasid period.
